pre.spec: Skill on rows no model saw (board dev91-freshprobe-v1). Blocks by cols_h458.py closure fresh-probe: SEARCH context unchanged, probe rows as queries, GP anchor off. <tag>_rr, _yj, _rg are the three direct ICL columns (ridge-residual, Yeo-Johnson, rank-Gauss) and <tag>_mean3 their equal-weight mean; use ref = the full-SEARCH refit. init = the checkpoint every H458 specialist was fine-tuned from (fleet_M_x2_h455_maxent/ckpt_valley_002.pt key ema, sha256 ba90b6efa2ccc003...), scored with the evaluation own four random-slot views. canon = the canonical-slot recall specialist of the family at 2,000 exposures per pool row, one copy per family, scored with one native-order canonical-slot view. The one-view against four-view difference is part of the arm. SECONDARY, descriptive: the same blocks per target mode, no baseline. Prediction: canon below init in each of the three modes on the family mean.
